An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit a vulnerability in the login interface's OAuth callback endpoint by crafting a malicious URL. items.title: CVE-2019-17563: Apache Tomcat session fixation in FORM authentication (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache Tomcat has a session fixation flaw in its FORM authentication. A remote attacker, without logging in, could fix a victim's session ID, but the victim must take an action and the window for the attack is narrow.

items.title: CVE-2018-1336: Apache Tomcat denial of service in the UTF-8 decoder (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache Tomcat, from the Apache Software Foundation, mishandles overflow in its UTF-8 decoder when it processes supplementary characters. A remote attacker who does not need to log in can trigger an infinite loop and cause a denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2019-0199: Apache Tomcat denial of service in HTTP/2 stream handling (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache Tomcat is affected by a flaw in its HTTP/2 handling that lets a remote attacker, without logging in, open streams and keep them open while sending excessive SETTINGS frames and never reading or writing data. This ties up server threads running blocking I/O, which can exhaust them and cause a denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-137970
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in ssrf-protection.ts that fails to classify NAT64 (64:ff9b::/96, 64:ff9b:1::/48) and 6to4 (2002::/16) IPv6 addresses embedding internal IPv4. Authenticated users can set REST API, GraphQL, OpenAPI, or OAuth data-source URLs to attacker hostnames whose AAAA records resolve to these forms, bypassing pre-request and dial-time guards to reach cloud metadata and internal hosts.

items.title: CVE-2026-137969
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a server-side request forgery protection bypass because getSSRFProtectionOptions passes its safe resolver as dnsLookup instead of lookup. Attackers controlling datasource hostnames can use DNS rebinding in REST API, GraphQL, OpenAPI, or OAuth requests to reach blocked private addresses.

items.title: dynmx
items.summary: dynmx Prototype dynmx spoken dynamics is a signature-based detection approach for behavioural malware features based on Windows API call sequences. In a simplified way, you can think of dynmx as a sort of YARA for API call traces so called function logs originating from malware sandboxes. Hence, the data basis for the detection approach are not the malware samples themselves which are analyzed statically but data that is generated during a dynamic analysis of the malware sample in a malware sandbox. Malicious scanned hosts can observe math.random-derived values in NSE script traffic during -sC scans, brute-force the seed, and recover a heap address that weakens ASLR.

items.title: CVE-2026-137978
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in DNS::ResolverImpl::process_request in libnetutil/massdns.cc that frees still-referenced requests when rescheduling after DNS server disconnects. Attackers answering for at least two configured DNS servers can force a disconnect and send a precisely timed response to crash the scan, possibly enabling code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-137965
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users with the TEST_CONNECTION ability to reach arbitrary hosts by supplying body-controlled datasource options. Attackers can set kind, plugin_id, and host options for plugins like influxdb or elasticsearch to reach loopback, internal services, or cloud metadata endpoints exposing IAM credentials.

items.title: CVE-2026-137960
items.summary: Budibase backend-core before 3.49.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated Builder/Creator users to bypass the outbound-fetch deny list by targeting the IPv6 unspecified address. Attackers can supply URLs with host [::] to features like Outgoing Webhook or REST datasources to reach IPv6 loopback services and read reflected internal responses.

items.title: CVE-2026-137957
items.summary: n8n before 1.123.96, 2.47.6, 2.48.3, and 3.2.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability in integration nodes that build API request paths from unencoded record, table, or resource ID parameters. Attackers can supply relative path segments through untrusted input such as webhook bodies to read, modify, or delete unintended resources using the node's stored credential.

items.title: CVE-2026-137952
items.summary: svglib before 2.5.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in SvgRenderer.renderNode() that recursively renders internal href fragment references without expansion limits or cycle detection. Attackers can supply crafted SVGs to svg2rlg() with nested groups referencing each other twice or self-referencing images to cause exponential resource consumption or RecursionError crashes.

items.title: CVE-2026-81055
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Observable Timing Discrepancy vulnerability. A low privileged remote attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Session theft.

items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection') vulnerability. items.title: CVE-2026-81042
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Information exposure.

items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper Certificate Validation vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Denial of service and Information exposure.

items.title: CVE-2026-137999
items.summary: JSONSchema2PoPo2 through 3.0.3 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers to inject Python code by supplying JSON Schema default or format values that are written unescaped. Attackers can place a single quote in a string property default to break out of the literal in the generated __init__ signature, executing injected code when the generated module is imported.

items.title: CVE-2026-137998
items.summary: Detoxify 0.5.3 through 0.5.4 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability in load_checkpoint that allows attackers to execute code by supplying a crafted checkpoint file. Attackers can embed a pickle __reduce__ gadget in a .ckpt file loaded via torch.load with weights_only=False to run code with the user's privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-137997
items.summary: HCIPy through 0.7.1 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code by supplying crafted .pkl files to read_field, read_grid or read_mode_basis. Because hcipy/util/io.py selects pickle by file extension and calls pickle.load, a __reduce__ gadget in a pupil, apodizer, PSF or mode-basis file runs code with the user's privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-137994
items.summary: Leo through 6.8.10 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code by embedding pickled data in unknown XML attributes of .leo outlines. Attackers can place a pickle __reduce__ gadget in a or element attribute that resolveUa passes to pickle.loads, executing code with user privileges when the outline is opened.

items.title: CVE-2026-137992
items.summary: libexpat through 2.11.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in defineAttribute() of lib/xmlparse.c that fails to detect duplicate non-ID #IMPLIED or #REQUIRED attribute declarations. Attackers can supply a crafted XML document with repeated ATTLIST declarations in an internal DTD subset to cause quadratic CPU consumption in storeAtts() during parsing.

Attackers controlling or on-path to a DNS server can send timed DNS responses with forged ICMP port-unreachable messages to crash scans, disclose memory, or hijack execution.

items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization ('Race Condition') vulnerability. items.title: CVE-2026-137973
items.summary: Heym from 0.0.95 before 0.0.154 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to run script on the application origin by publishing HTML output mapper workflows. Attackers can set a workflow to anonymous GET and share the /api/workflows/{id}/execute link, causing visitors' browsers to send authenticated API requests to read or modify their workflows, credentials, and settings.

items.title: CVE-2026-137972
items.summary: Heym before 0.0.154 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the workflow execute endpoint: anonymous workflows run as any signed-in caller, without an access check, using that caller's credentials and global variables. Authenticated attackers can lure signed-in users to a GET execute link for an attacker-owned anonymous workflow, which the SameSite=Lax session cookie authenticates. The attacker then reads the victim's decrypted credentials from the workflow's run history.

items.title: CVE-2026-137967
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to make the server fetch internal URLs via the gRPC v2 proto_file_url option. Attackers can target loopback, private, cloud metadata, or redirect-controlled addresses, or serve oversized responses that are buffered and parsed synchronously, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-137966
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an arbitrary file read and SSRF vulnerability in the SMTP plugin that allows authenticated app builders to pass object values to Nodemailer. Attackers can set textContent or htmlContent to path or href content objects to email server files or internal cloud metadata responses to themselves.

items.title: CVE-2026-137964
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a command injection vulnerability in its GitHub Actions release workflow, which interpolates the pull request title directly into a shell run block. Attackers can submit a pull request against a release branch with shell metacharacters in its title that, once merged, executes commands with a cross-repository GITHUB_TOKEN, enabling unauthorized merges into enterprise repositories.

items.title: CVE-2026-137962
items.summary: Budibase server before 3.48.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the public API view row search endpoint that skips per-view permission checks due to a tableId/viewId parameter mismatch. Authenticated users with READ_ONLY role and an API key can query restricted views to read data limited to higher-privileged roles.

items.title: CVE-2026-137961
items.summary: Budibase before 3.51.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the workspace create handler that allows authenticated CREATOR users to probe server paths by supplying an unvalidated body.file.path value. Attackers can enumerate filesystem existence and type, and for directories containing db.txt, copy contents into their object store namespace before the directory is recursively deleted.

items.title: CVE-2026-137959
items.summary: n8n before 1.123.96, 2.x before 2.47.6, 2.48.x before 2.48.3, and 3.x before 3.2.2 does not verify that the user activating a workflow can access the credentials set on its trigger nodes. An authenticated member who knows another user's credential ID can activate a workflow whose trigger uses it, causing n8n to create or delete webhooks on the connected service with that credential's privileges and deliver events from attacker-chosen resources to the member's workflow.

items.title: CVE-2026-137958
items.summary: n8n before 2.47.6, 2.48.x before 2.48.3, and 3.x before 3.2.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the AWS Bedrock Chat Model and Embeddings AWS Bedrock nodes, where requests to a custom Bedrock runtime endpoint set in an AWS credential bypass n8n's SSRF protection. An authenticated user who can create AWS credentials can point the endpoint at internal or blocked addresses, causing n8n to send requests there and exposing the start of responses in node errors.

items.title: CVE-2026-137956

Attackers can supply crafted 32-bit float media, such as PFM or OpenEXR images, that when processed by the boxblur filter overflow the temporary buffers, crashing applications or possibly executing code.

items.summary: Flowintel contains a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in its HedgeDoc case-notes integration. When a user with editor or administrator privileges associates a HedgeDoc URL with a case, the application later issues a server-side HTTP GET request to that URL to retrieve note content. Before the fix, the stored URL was used directly without validation of its scheme, host, port, path, or userinfo, and the HTTP client followed redirects by default with no connect or read timeouts. An authenticated attacker could therefore cause the Flowintel server to issue requests to arbitrary int…

items.title: CVE-2026-137911
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in xwd_encode_frame() in libavcodec/xwdenc.c that copies each RGB24 or BGR24 row using the padded XWD scanline size instead of the pixel row size. Attackers who control the width of video encoded to XWD by an application that supplies tightly packed frames can make the encoder read past the frame buffer, crashing the application or leaking heap contents into the output image.

items.title: CVE-2026-137910
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in pcx_encode_frame() in libavcodec/pcxenc.c that rounds each row up to an even number of bytes and run-length encodes that many bytes from the input frame. Attackers who control the width of images encoded to PCX by an application that supplies tightly packed frames can make the encoder read past the end of the frame buffer, crashing the application or leaking heap contents into the output image.

items.title: CVE-2026-137909
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xsub_encode() in libavcodec/xsubenc.c that only warns when a subtitle has no rectangles and then dereferences rects[0]. Attackers can supply crafted PGS or DVB subtitles that decode to empty subtitle events, crashing applications that pass decoded subtitles directly to the XSUB encoder.

items.title: CVE-2026-137908
items.summary: FFmpeg 7.1 before 9.1 contains a memory leak vulnerability in eb_receive_packet() in libavcodec/libsvtav1.c that returns without unreferencing the queued input frame when eb_send_frame() fails. Attackers can supply crafted video in which some frames lack Dolby Vision metadata to an SVT-AV1 encode with Dolby Vision RPU coding enabled, leaking each rejected frame's buffers or aborting in av_frame_move_ref() in builds with assertions enabled.

items.title: CVE-2026-137905
items.summary: FFmpeg 5.0 before 8.1.3 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in parse_imf_asset_map_from_xml_dom() in libavformat/imfdec.c that does not check for a missing or empty Path element in an asset map Chunk. Attackers can supply a crafted IMF ASSETMAP.xml whose Chunk lacks a Path, passing a NULL URI to the path handling functions and crashing the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-107189
items.summary: GNU m4 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in reload_frozen_state() in src/freeze.c. When processing a malicious frozen-state file via the -R option, an attacker can trigger an oversized allocation request that crashes the program, causing denial of service. This issue was fixed in commit 69aef802fb25ab600d37210f44e5128633cbc432.

items.title: CVE-2026-137940
items.summary: Pillow through 13.1.0 contains an integer overflow in the ImageMath integer divide and modulo operators (DIV_I and MOD_I in src/_imagingmath.c), which guard only against a zero divisor, so dividing INT32_MIN by -1 raises a hardware divide exception. Attackers can supply a crafted TIFF that decodes to a mode I image containing INT32_MIN, crashing applications that run an ImageMath divide or modulo with a -1 operand on it.

items.title: CVE-2026-137937
items.summary: PDFio before 1.6.5 contains an integer underflow in _pdfioCryptoAESDecrypt() in pdfio-aes.c, which strips PKCS#7 padding before any AES block has been decrypted when an AES-encrypted string or binary value holds only its 16-byte IV. Attackers can supply a crafted AES-encrypted PDF that, when opened with pdfioFileOpen(), makes the decrypted length underflow so that _pdfioValueDecrypt() reads and writes out of bounds, crashing the application or corrupting heap memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-137609
items.summary: In Eclipse Krazo Extensions up to and including 3.0.0, AsciiDocViewEngine passes MVC model values to Asciidoctor as document attributes without encoding them. Asciidoctor substitutes attribute references after it escapes HTML special characters and before it processes inline macros. As a result, attacker-controlled model values end up in the output as raw HTML and can inject AsciiDoc inline macros. This allows cross-site scripting in applications that render untrusted data through AsciiDoc views.

items.title: CVE-2026-133845
items.summary: A flaw was found in Flatpak’s flatpak-portal. When a sandboxed application invokes Spawn() and maps two different file descriptors to the same handle, dup2() can fail. Affected Flatpak versions do not handle that failure, so a file descriptor that was open inside flatpak-portal (commonly the unfiltered D-Bus session bus) can be passed into the subsandbox. A malicious or compromised Flatpak app with no special privileges can use this to escape the sandbox.

items.title: CVE-2026-133842
items.summary: A flaw was found in Flatpak’s flatpak-system-helper. When a system-wide app, runtime, or extension uses the extra-data mechanism and its apply_extra logic creates a deeply nested directory tree, permission canonicalization can fail (for example with EMFILE). Affected Flatpak versions can still report success without clearing setuid/setgid bits, leaving a setuid-root executable under /var/lib/flatpak. A local attacker who can install or update such content system-wide, or who can already execute code as a local user in cooperation with that content, can escalate privileges to root.

items.title: CVE-2026-132890
items.summary: In Eclipse Dataspace Components (EDC) Connector 1.0.0-RC2 through 1.0.0-RC7, the HashiCorp Vault extension does not reject .. path segments in secret aliases. In a multi-participant (virtual) control plane where vault partitions share the runtime's Vault token, an authenticated participant can set a callback secret alias that escapes its own vault partition. The connector then reads secrets of other participants or of the runtime, such as STS client secrets or the encryption key, and sends them to an endpoint the attacker chooses.

items.title: CVE-2026-115841
items.summary: A flaw was found in sequoia-openpgp. DSA signature verification does not reject a public key with generator 1 and public value 1 before calling the cryptographic backend. Upstream reports that the Nettle and OpenSSL backends, including the default Nettle build, accept this key. Under that key, a signature can verify for every message. Ordinary DSA keys are not affected. An application is exposed when that degenerate certificate is accepted as authoritative.

items.title: CVE-2026-115836
items.summary: A flaw was found in sequoia-openpgp. The default ASCII-armor parser accepts Unicode dash characters in armor framing and ignores leading quote characters. A crafted byte stream can be parsed as one message by this tolerant parser and as a different message by a strict ASCII-armor parser. The strict mode is opt-in; the default parser remains tolerant.

items.title: CVE-2026-115835
items.summary: A flaw was found in sequoia-openpgp. The ASCII-armor reader does not limit the length of a line. Parsing an armored message with a very long line can exhaust memory in the process. Memory use follows the input size, with a small constant factor, and is not a classic amplification.

This issue affects the function ab32_get_adc_value of the file bsp/bluetrum/libraries/hal_drivers/drv_adc.c of the component ADC Driver. The manipulation of the argument channel leads to improper validation of array index. The attack can only be performed from a local environment. The identifier of the patch is 7f1f625f36232fd165a8a8313b1612846215aece. To fix this issue, it is recommended to deploy a patch.

items.title: CVE-2026-115834
items.summary: A flaw was found in sequoia-openpgp. items.title: PowerToysのコマンドパレット経由でエラー448、開発ツールに影響との報告
items.summary: PowerToysのコマンドパレットから起動したWindows Terminalで一部の開発ツールが動作しなくなる問題が報告された。検証ではWindowsの保護機能RedirectionGuardの設定が起動経路によって異なっていた。

items.title: 英国雇用年金省、サイバーインシデントで一部サービス停止。通常の給付金・年金は支払い継続へ
items.summary: 英国雇用年金省はシステムに影響するサイバーインシデントを検知し、オンラインサービスの一部を予防的に停止した。通常の給付金や年金は予定通り支払うとしている。給付制度ユニバーサルクレジットの申請やログインにも支障が出たとみられる。

items.title: ロリポップ！で顧客情報漏えい、Basic認証などのパスワードを平文保存
items.summary: GMOペパボのロリポップ！関連サービスで顧客情報が漏えいした。漏えいした認証情報には利用者が設定したBasic認証のパスワードもあり、平文で保存されていた。退会済み利用者の削除対象データが一部残っていたことも判明した。

items.title: GTA VIの偽PC版、GitHubで発見。ファイル検査済みをうたうClickFix攻撃
items.summary: GTA VIのPC版をうたう偽の配布ページがGitHubで見つかった。ファイルの検査を済ませたと宣伝しながら、実際には利用者に外部から取得したコードを実行するよう求めていた。

items.title: インド選挙管理委員会のサイトで個人情報漏えいの恐れ、電話相談機能の不具合を修正
items.summary: インド選挙管理委員会のWebサイトで電話相談を申し込む際に、画面には表示されない個人情報や本人確認書類の保存先がブラウザーに送られていた。不具合は修正されており、個人情報の大量取得につながる危険性が指摘された。

items.title: エコめがね、外部クラウドにも不正アクセス。全量・余剰の全面復旧は2027年2月上旬目標
items.summary: NTTスマイルエナジーの太陽光発電遠隔監視サービス、エコめがねへの不正アクセスが外部クラウドにも及んでいたことが判明した。一部取引先の口座情報などに漏えいの恐れがあり、全量・余剰エコめがねは新たなシステム基盤での再開を目指す。

items.title: GMO、サイバー・イージス構想で攻撃の選択的遮断を提案。対策ソフト無償配布へ
items.summary: GMOインターネットグループがサイバー・イージス構想を発表した。攻撃に利用されるIPアドレスからの通信を選択的に遮断し、被害防止と通信の秘密の保護を両立させることを目指す。個人・中小企業向けの対策ソフトも無償配布する計画を掲げた。

items.title: 英検・日商簿記・統計検定、マイナンバーカードで本人確認と結果証明を実証へ
items.summary: デジタル庁は2027年1月中旬から英検、日商簿記検定、統計検定でマイナンバーカードを活用する実証を始める予定。受験申込時の本人確認から試験結果のデジタル証明書の提出までを共通仕様案に基づいて検証する。対象は事前に同意した受験者に限られる。

items.title: 日本政府、サイバー攻撃の被害が懸念される企業に自ら連絡する専門チームを発足
items.summary: 日本政府は11月27日、国家サイバー統括室にアウトリーチ・チームを発足させた。国内外から得た脅威情報を基に企業へ働き掛け、組織自身が気付いていない侵害の早期発見と対策を促す。

items.title: 防衛省、AI活用の新方針を公表。特定事業者への過度な依存を回避へ
items.summary: 防衛省がAIとデータの活用方針Defense AI Visionを公表した。人が最終判断と責任を担う原則を示し、特定事業者への過度な依存を避けるためにAIを自ら選択・改良・移行できる能力を維持する方針を掲げた。

items.title: 大阪大学、メールアドレス漏えいを確認し災害時の安否確認システムを停止
items.summary: 大阪大学は11月27日、外部のメール配信サービスへの不正アクセスにより学生と教職員の登録メールアドレスが漏えいしたと発表した。安否確認システムANPICの安全性を確認できるまで利用を停止し、必要な安否確認は大学からのメールなどで代替する。

items.title: 日経、委託先KARTEへの不正アクセスで日経ID利用者の個人情報約540万件の漏えいを確認
items.summary: 日本経済新聞社は11月27日、外部サービスKARTEへの不正アクセスにより日経ID利用者の個人情報539万9986件の漏えいを確認したと発表した。日経電子版の会員に加え新聞宅配や専門メディアの購読で日経IDを登録した人も対象に含まれる。

items.title: マイナアプリに脆弱性、2026.11.0未満でマイナンバーカード情報窃取の恐れ
items.summary: デジタル庁が提供するマイナアプリのiOS版とAndroid版に複数の脆弱性が見つかった。不正なリンクを開いた利用者が意図しないサイトへ誘導され、フィッシング被害に遭う恐れがある。アプリの最新版への更新が推奨されている。

items.title: Binanceグローバル、63億ドル規模の暗号資産流出に伴う出庫停止を全面解除
items.summary: 暗号資産取引所Binanceが10月の資産流出を受けて進めてきたグローバル版の出庫復旧作業を完了した。預かり資産の補填は先に完了しており、日本法人は国内の再開状況を個別に案内している。

items.title: 日銀、トークン化国債の資金決済などを検討。AIによる取引自動化も想定
